lines: Devang Mehta, an Investor Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 16,650 shares in the offer for sale, bringing in up to ₹2.25 crore if all offered shares are sold (medium confidence: holdings found in one section only).
Gain is up to ₹1.66 crore before offer expenses and taxes; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Retained stake is an estimated ₹5.25 crore at offer price, though the money is already in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), which makes the call timely now.
